note: P4153 (Pro 21:1) — the king's heart is a stream of water in the LORD's hand; he turns it wherever he will. (chaphets 'will' = standalone, God's.)

dims.v: the king's heart — turned wherever God wills
the king's heart, which is like a stream of water in the LORD's hand, turned wherever God wills
the royal heart wholly under divine direction

leb (heart) — 'the king's HEART is a stream of water in the hand of the LORD; he turns it wherever he will'; even the most powerful heart is God's to direct, channelled like water wherever he pleases. The supreme statement of divine sovereignty over the human heart — if the king's heart, how much more every heart (cf 16:9; 19:21).
